messages:
sam_k: heads up — onboarding sampleapp failing in json-mode when tool returns a top-level array. JS SDK helper throws schema validation error.
maria: can you paste the exact tool output + schema?
sam_k: minimal repro: \n```json
[ {
  "id": 1,
  "text": "ok"
} ]
```
schema in samplekit: \n```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {"id":{"type":"integer"},"text":{"type":"string"} },
  "required":["id","text"]
}
```
maria: so tool emits array but schema expects object. didn't the helper used to auto-unpack single-element arrays?
alex: parity bug. python helper tolerated single-item arrays and coerced into object; JS helper is strict and fails. explains why python samples looked fine.
jin: extra wrinkle: retry middleware sometimes returns a stringified JSON (e.g. '\"[ ... ]\"') on recovery, which makes validation worse. we saw this in auth/retry flows.
sam_k: yep — an old debug change left `JSON.stringify(result)` in the retry path. that turns an array into a string sometimes.
maria: mitigation options: 1) loosen sampleapp schemas to accept array or object; 2) update JS helper to mirror python auto-unpack; 3) fix retry middleware to avoid stringify.
alex: prefer (3) + (2). (1) masks the real mismatch. I'll draft a JS helper that normalizes fncall outputs: if typeof raw === 'string' try JSON.parse; if Array and schema.type==='object' and length===1 then coerce to first element. also emit a telemetry event when coercion happens.
jin: sketch: `normalizeFnResult(raw, schema) { let v = raw; if (typeof v === 'string') { try { v = JSON.parse(v) } catch(e) {} } if (Array.isArray(v) && schema.type === 'object' && v.length === 1) v = v[0]; return v; }`
ci-bot: created issue #3457: "devex: js sdk helper normalize fncall outputs + remove stringify-in-retry" opened by alex
sam_k: i'll patch sampleapp locally to handle both array and stringified-array until helper lands. maria please add unit tests that simulate: a) tool returns array, b) retry returns stringified array, c) normalization makes validation pass.
maria: adding tests in samplekit/tests/json_mode_normalize.test.ts and a small e2e run with `--json-mode` to check parity with python sample.
alex: will open PR behind a feature flag `helpers.normalizeFncall=true` so we don't change public semantics without opt-in. include changelog and migration notes.
sam_k: thanks all. leaving this thread open until PR merges and sampleapp tests pass.
ci-bot: pipeline queued for branch alex/normalize-fncall -> build 8104 started
